message.reasoning:
The user asks: "洛杉磯和柏林之間的時差是多少？" (What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?). They want the time difference. We need to provide the answer. There's no mention of needing coordinates. But we might need to consider daylight saving changes. The question likely expects the current time difference. We can compute it. Los Angeles is Pacific Time Zone (PT), which is UTC-8 standard, UTC-7 during DST. Berlin is Central European Time (CET) UTC+1 standard, UTC+2 during DST.

We need to know if both cities are currently observing DST. As of now, it's July 20, 2026. In 2026, DST will start in March and end in October for both. So both are on DST. So Los Angeles is UTC-7, Berlin is UTC+2. So the difference is 9 hours ahead. Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles. So the time difference is +9 hours. So answer: Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles. If they ask "time difference", we can say "Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles". Or "Los Angeles is 9 hours behind Berlin".

Thus answer: 9 hours. No need to call function.
